exceptions.reason: ESLint 9 is EOL, but the current React lint dependency chain still contains packages whose declared peer ranges do not cleanly include ESLint 10. Do not force-install or override peer dependencies in a public release.
exceptions.resolution: Dependabot security updates remain enabled. Routine Web version PRs are paused until Dependabot supports the repository's pinned pnpm 11 and can update the root lockfile. Re-evaluate the peer graph and updater support before expiry; the static source audit fails after the expiry date.
